title: HLSFactory-Agent: Large-Scale Agentic HLS Dataset Construction from Academic and Open-Source Projects
abstract: arXiv:2609.09519v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Building large, diverse datasets of high-level synthesis (HLS) designs beyond common community benchmarks remains an open challenge. This challenge is made urgent by the rise of deep learning and LLMs for hardware design, which demand such datasets to train QoR models and benchmark LLMs on HLS tasks. Despite ongoing efforts to broaden sources, dataset curation still depends on manual work: locating HLS designs across academic publications and open source, then extracting standalone designs from larger codebases. The process is error-prone and demands expert knowledge, iterative testing, and substantial per-repository engineering.   To address this, we present HLSFactory-Agent, an LLM agent that automates large-scale HLS dataset curation by extracting standalone designs from larger codebases. translated_title: HLSFactory-Agent：基于学术和开源项目的大规模智能体式HLS数据集构建
translated_abstract: 构建超出常见社区基准的大规模、多样化的高层次综合（HLS）设计数据集仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。随着深度学习和大型语言模型（LLM）在硬件设计领域的兴起，这一挑战变得愈发紧迫，因为这些应用需要此类数据集来训练QoR（结果质量）预测模型，并在HLS任务上对LLM进行基准测试。尽管学界一直在努力拓宽数据来源，但数据集的整理工作仍然依赖人工：需要在学术论文和开源项目中寻找HLS设计，再从更大的代码库中提取出独立的设计。这一过程容易出错，需要专业知识、反复测试以及针对每个代码库的大量工程投入。为解决这一问题，我们提出了HLSFactory-Agent，一个通过从更大的代码库中提取独立设计来实现大规模HLS数据集整理自动化的LLM智能体。HLSFactory-Agent在Docker容器中运行开源的Pi智能体框架，以构建并评估每个提取出的设计。这种开箱即用的自动化方案……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: HLSFactory-Agent是一个基于LLM的智能体系统，能够自动从学术论文和开源代码库中提取、构建并评估独立的HLS设计，从而实现大规模HLS数据集构建的全自动化，克服了传统人工整理耗时、易错且需大量专业知识的问题。
en_tdlr: HLSFactory-Agent is an LLM-powered agent that automates large-scale HLS dataset curation by extracting, building, and evaluating standalone designs from academic publications and open-source codebases, replacing the error-prone and labor-intensive manual curation process.
